_comment: Copy to demo/config.json and replace every address with the real one. Find each machine's address with 'ipconfig getifaddr en0' on macOS, 'ip addr' on Linux, or 'ipconfig' on Windows.

cloud_machine._role: Computer A -- runs sim.cloud.server on 8443 (authorised) and a second instance on 8444 (rogue)

ops_machine._role: Computer B -- runs sinks.alert_receiver, shows the dashboard

pi._role: Raspberry Pi -- SDR receiver, packet capture, both monitors
